description: AZAS (Astro-Zonal Assessment & Scheduling) is a team of five students from Inha University, South Korea, participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We developed LAMP (Lunar Access and Mission Planning), an interactive platform that lets users explore the journey from Earth to the Moon. Our goal is to make the experience of planning a lunar mission more accessible, intuitive, and engaging for everyone interested in space exploration.
